title: Rav Yehudah of Sura

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 89a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.89a.7-8) records his valuable exposition of the verse: “You shall not have in your house”—why? Because of “ephah and ephah.” “You shall not have in your pouch”—why? Because of “stone and stone.” But “a whole and just stone” (then) “you shall have.” Hyman cites Niddah 27a for the scriptural proof that the Levites kept watch at twenty-one places. Hyman infers from the passage that Rav Yehuda preceded Abaye.[^1]

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=199) gives Niddah 27a. The matching discussion is at [Tamid 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Tamid.27a.3-5): the proof for twenty-one posts is attributed to Rav Yehudah or to a baraita, and Abaye answers an objection to the count. Hyman uses the passage to infer that Rav Yehudah preceded him.
